How Do I Schedule Many Telegram Posts at Once? (Bulk Scheduling with SetDate)
Scheduling one post is quick. Scheduling
thirty
— a week of content for a news channel, a course drip, a product launch sequence — needs a different tool:
SetDate
, the companion bot built for exactly this.
The five-minute bulk workflow
1. Open SetDate.
directly — or tap
📅 Use SetDate Bot
whenever Fast Scheduler suggests it.
2. Feed it content.
Send your messages one after another — text, photos, videos, anything you would schedule normally.
3. Choose a start date
and how many posts should go out per day.
4. Define posting times
— for example 09:00, 14:00 and 18:00 — and SetDate distributes your messages across that grid.
5. Send the batch back.
One tap and every message appears in Fast Scheduler as a normal scheduled post, fully editable afterwards.
Why this beats scheduling by hand
One sitting instead of thirty.
You write all content while you are in the writing mood, then let the grid place it.
Perfect for recurring formats.
A daily tip at 10:00 for the next two weeks is two fields in SetDate, not fourteen conversations.
Everything stays editable.
After import, each post is a regular scheduled message — search it, edit it, delete it, or move it in the calendar.
Bulk for repeated content: recurring messages
If the
same
message should repeat — a weekly digest, a daily reminder — you do not need bulk import at all: create a
recurring message
once and it reschedules itself. Free plans run 1 recurring message; Premium removes the cap (Unlimited) and its rules never expire.
Tip: before importing a large batch, glance at your channel’s time zone (see the time-zone guide) so the grid lands on the hours you actually meant.
Common questions
What is the SetDate bot?
SetDate is Fast Scheduler’s companion bot for bulk scheduling: you prepare many messages there, choose a start date and daily posting times, and import them all into Fast Scheduler in one click.
Can I edit posts after bulk import?
Yes. Imported messages become ordinary scheduled messages — open the Message List or calendar and edit, move or delete any of them individually.
Can I Edit a Scheduled Post After Scheduling It?
How many posts can I import at once?
Imported messages count against your scheduled-message limit (100 pending on Free, unlimited on Premium), so a batch that fits your queue can be imported in one go.
